import test from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import {SECTORS,EXCHANGE,canShowMedicationHistory,sectorPresentation,sectorKey,freshState,visibleDocuments,transitionDocument,shareDocument,createRequest,reviewRequest,recordDentalReport,completeReport,createIntent,reviewIntent,calendarExample} from '../../public/vereda/portal/core.js';

test('ten distinct sectors and invalid routes fail to a known demo',()=>{assert.equal(Object.keys(SECTORS).length,10);assert.equal(sectorKey('__proto__'),'odontologia');assert.equal(sectorKey('advocacia'),'advocacia');assert.equal(sectorKey(null),'odontologia');});
test('all sectors open with only released documents for the titular',()=>{for(const key of Object.keys(SECTORS)){const state=freshState(key);assert.equal(visibleDocuments(state).length,2);assert.ok(visibleDocuments(state).every(d=>d.status==='published'));assert.equal(SECTORS[key].journey.length,4);}});
test('independent sector state does not share writable arrays',()=>{const one=freshState('medicina'),two=freshState('medicina');one.docs[0].status='draft';one.requests.push({});assert.equal(two.docs[0].status,'published');assert.equal(two.requests.length,0);});
test('client cannot release a draft; professional can release then revoke',()=>{const s=freshState();assert.equal(transitionDocument(s,'document-3','published').ok,false);s.role='professional';assert.equal(transitionDocument(s,'document-3','published').ok,true);s.role='client';assert.equal(visibleDocuments(s).length,3);assert.equal(shareDocument(s,'document-3').ok,true);s.role='professional';assert.equal(transitionDocument(s,'document-3','draft').ok,true);assert.equal(s.docs[2].shared,false);s.role='client';assert.equal(visibleDocuments(s).length,2);});
test('reception view receives no document and cannot release or share',()=>{const s=freshState();s.role='professional';s.staffRole='reception';assert.deepEqual(visibleDocuments(s),[]);assert.equal(transitionDocument(s,'document-3','published').ok,false);assert.equal(shareDocument(s,'document-1').ok,false);});
test('draft and missing documents cannot receive a sharing permission',()=>{const s=freshState();assert.equal(shareDocument(s,'document-3').ok,false);assert.equal(shareDocument(s,'missing').ok,false);});
test('a client sharing permission can be revoked without changing document',()=>{const s=freshState();assert.equal(shareDocument(s,'document-1').ok,true);assert.equal(s.docs[0].shared,true);shareDocument(s,'document-1');assert.equal(s.docs[0].shared,false);assert.equal(s.docs[0].status,'published');});
test('appointment requests are pending and duplicate active slot is refused',()=>{const s=freshState();assert.equal(createRequest(s,'2026-11-05T09:00').ok,true);assert.equal(s.requests[0].status,'pending');assert.equal(createRequest(s,'2026-11-05T09:00').ok,false);assert.equal(createRequest(s,'2099-01-01T10:00').ok,false);assert.equal(s.requests.length,1);});
test('client cannot confirm, team confirms only pending requests',()=>{const s=freshState();createRequest(s,'2026-11-05T09:00');assert.equal(reviewRequest(s,'request-1','confirmed').ok,false);s.role='professional';assert.equal(reviewRequest(s,'request-1','confirmed').ok,true);assert.equal(reviewRequest(s,'request-1','confirmed').ok,false);assert.equal(s.requests[0].status,'confirmed');});
test('cancelled requests may be replaced by a new pending request',()=>{const s=freshState();createRequest(s,'2026-11-05T09:00');assert.equal(reviewRequest(s,'request-1','cancelled').ok,true);assert.equal(createRequest(s,'2026-11-05T09:00').ok,true);assert.equal(s.requests.length,2);assert.equal(s.requests[1].status,'pending');});
test('dental reports require patient perspective and valid selected regions',()=>{const s=freshState();assert.equal(recordDentalReport(s).ok,false);s.dental=[1,32];assert.equal(recordDentalReport(s).ok,true);assert.deepEqual(s.reports[0].regions,[1,32]);assert.deepEqual(s.dental,[]);s.dental=[33];assert.equal(recordDentalReport(s).ok,false);s.dental=[2];s.role='professional';assert.equal(recordDentalReport(s).ok,false);});
test('dental reporting does not operate in another sector',()=>{const s=freshState('medicina');s.dental=[2];assert.equal(recordDentalReport(s).ok,false);assert.equal(s.reports.length,0);});
test('report review requires responsible professional and is single transition',()=>{const s=freshState();s.dental=[2];recordDentalReport(s);assert.equal(completeReport(s,'report-1').ok,false);s.role='professional';s.staffRole='reception';assert.equal(completeReport(s,'report-1').ok,false);s.staffRole='owner';assert.equal(completeReport(s,'report-1').ok,true);assert.equal(completeReport(s,'report-1').ok,false);});
test('calendar export is tentative, generic and explicit about demonstration',()=>{const value=calendarExample();assert.match(value,/STATUS:TENTATIVE/);assert.match(value,/DTSTART:20261105T120000Z/);assert.match(value,/DEMONSTRACAO/);assert.doesNotMatch(value,/Marina|medicamento|diagnostico|processo/);assert.ok(value.endsWith('\r\n'));});
test('sector-specific administrative requests reject the wrong sector',()=>{const s=freshState('petshop');assert.equal(createIntent(s,'restock','Lembrete demonstrativo').ok,true);assert.equal(createIntent(s,'repeat-order','Pedido fictício').ok,false);assert.equal(s.intents.length,1);});
test('administrative requests do not duplicate pending actions',()=>{const s=freshState('pizzaria');assert.equal(createIntent(s,'repeat-order','Pedido anterior').ok,true);assert.equal(createIntent(s,'repeat-order','Pedido anterior').ok,false);assert.equal(s.intents[0].status,'pending');});
test('administrative review requires a team perspective and preserves context',()=>{const s=freshState('salao');createIntent(s,'staff-preference','Profissional fictícia A');assert.equal(reviewIntent(s,'intent-1').ok,false);s.role='professional';assert.equal(reviewIntent(s,'intent-1').ok,true);assert.equal(s.intents[0].detail,'Profissional fictícia A');assert.equal(reviewIntent(s,'intent-1').ok,false);});
test('psychology is default and never receives prescription history',()=>{const s=freshState('psiquiatria');assert.equal(s.mentalService,'psychology');assert.equal(canShowMedicationHistory(s),false);assert.equal(sectorPresentation(s).label,'Psicologia');});
test('psychiatry selection changes service and enables inactive history module only',()=>{const s=freshState('psiquiatria');s.mentalService='psychiatry';assert.equal(canShowMedicationHistory(s),true);assert.equal(sectorPresentation(s).label,'Psiquiatria');assert.match(sectorPresentation(s).service,/psiquiátrica/);s.mentalService='psychology';assert.equal(canShowMedicationHistory(s),false);});
test('aesthetics, petshop and other nonmedical sectors cannot show prescribing module',()=>{for(const key of ['estetica','petshop','pizzaria','salao','hotelaria','imobiliaria','advocacia'])assert.equal(canShowMedicationHistory(freshState(key)),false);assert.equal(canShowMedicationHistory(freshState('odontologia')),true);assert.equal(canShowMedicationHistory(freshState('medicina')),true);});
test('each sector specifies necessary inputs, delivery and data-minimization boundary',()=>{assert.deepEqual(Object.keys(EXCHANGE).sort(),Object.keys(SECTORS).sort());for(const item of Object.values(EXCHANGE)){assert.equal(item.prepare.length,3);assert.equal(item.receive.length,3);assert.ok(item.avoid.length>40);}assert.match(EXCHANGE.pizzaria.avoid,/Não coletar histórico médico/);assert.match(EXCHANGE.petshop.avoid,/não é consulta veterinária/);assert.match(EXCHANGE.psiquiatria.avoid,/Psicologia não oferece prescrição/);});
